title: Locating specific named sub-areas (e.g. the Hundred Gallery, the drowned nave, the Hollow Throne stair) sometimes required blind directional wandering even after 'get your bearings' — bearings gave partial info that didn't always cover the quest target, forcing trial-and-error room-hopping.
